records.question: Does stablecoin liquidity provide incremental information about future 20-day canonical BRRK outcomes beyond the frozen price/regime information already available to BRRK-0011?
records.hypothesis: A prospectively frozen stablecoin-liquidity state contains incremental predictive information about future 20-day canonical BRRK net returns beyond the frozen BRRK price/regime state vector.
records.economic_mechanism: Changes in aggregate USD-pegged stablecoin supply may proxy changes in crypto-native deployable liquidity and risk appetite that are not fully represented by the frozen BRRK price/regime state.
records.stopping_rule: Do not retrieve full historical data or evaluate the model until the exact source/data contract and PIT semantics are frozen. Then run exactly one frozen Stage-1 information-test variant once. Release only the preregistered primary result classification and primary metric first. PASS may create a separately preregistered robustness-stage research ID; FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE stops this research ID with no rescue tuning.
success_criteria: At least 730 valid walk-forward OOS predictions remain after decision-time filtering, training-only normalization and 20-day label purging.
The mean baseline-minus-augmented squared-error loss differential is greater than zero.
A one-sided HAC test with maximum lag 19 rejects H0: mean loss differential <= 0 at alpha=0.05.
No PIT, provenance, data-contract, variant-budget or governance blocking finding occurs.
failure_criteria: FAIL_NO_INCREMENTAL_INFORMATION if the mean primary loss differential is <= 0 after the frozen run.
INCONCLUSIVE if the mean primary loss differential is > 0 but the one-sided HAC criterion is not met, or fewer than 730 valid OOS predictions remain.
Any PIT, provenance, unregistered-variant or data-contract violation invalidates the run rather than becoming a research result.
allowed_followup: Only PASS_INCREMENTAL_INFORMATION may create a new separately preregistered robustness-stage research ID.
A later portfolio-integration experiment requires a separate research ID after robustness and incremental-information admission; no direct integration is allowed from this Stage-1 result.
forbidden_followup: No same-ID feature, horizon, target, estimator, regularization, availability-lag, universe or threshold rescue after any result is observed.
No selection among USDT-only, USDC-only or other stablecoin decompositions based on observed performance.
No direct Edge Registry admission, BRRK modification, portfolio multiplier, leverage, short, Phase-7 activation or production authorization from this experiment.
researcher_decisions: Baseline is the canonical frozen P3.2 BRRK state/target path; do not rebuild a substitute price model.
Augmented model differs from baseline only by STABLECOIN_LIQUIDITY_STATE_V1.

STABLECOIN_LIQUIDITY_STATE_V1 is fixed as aggregate USD-pegged stablecoin supply 20-day log growth plus acceleration defined as current 20-day log growth minus the immediately preceding 20-day log growth.
Primary estimator is Ridge regression with alpha=1.0; no hyperparameter grid is permitted under this research ID.
All normalization is expanding and training-only; full-sample z-scores, winsorization, percentiles or quantiles are forbidden.
At decision timestamp T, only observations with available_at <= T may be used; 20-day labels not fully realized by T are purged from training.

If a historical source row lacks a verifiable publication timestamp, the primary reconstructed-history proxy is available_at = metric_date + 2 days. LAG_1D and LAG_3D are reserved for a separately preregistered robustness stage and cannot replace LAG_2D after observing this result.

If a source later exposes a verifiable historical publication timestamp, exact publication semantics may replace the proxy only if frozen in the data contract before the first result-bearing retrieval/evaluation.
USDT/USDC decomposition may be collected only as a predeclared diagnostic in a later contract and cannot substitute for the aggregate primary feature after seeing results.
records.production_relevance: Research-only Stage-1 external-information test. A PASS is eligible only for the next separately preregistered research stage and cannot change BRRK, phase authority or production authorization.
notes: Stage-1 executed exactly once under STABLECOIN-LIQUIDITY-0001-RUN-INTERFACE-V1 on merge dd50ec35085eee2a2883dc1b29e3dd21ec52b043 / workflow run 31264048473.

Primary result: FAIL_NO_INCREMENTAL_INFORMATION; valid OOS=933; mean baseline-minus-augmented squared-error differential=-5430210.12771038; HAC lag=19; t=-1.2454264237630361; one-sided p=0.8935124773215692.

The frozen failure rule mean_primary_loss_differential <= 0 triggered STOP. No alternative lag, alpha, horizon, feature representation, secondary metric, prediction table or coefficient path was evaluated or released to rescue the result.
No Stage-2 robustness research is eligible from this failed Stage-1 ID; Edge Registry remains unchanged and no portfolio or production authority is created.
RUN_ONCE_STAGE1.marker is retained permanently; this research ID may not be rerun.
ONCHAIN-HOLDER-COST-0001 remains separate backlog and is not started by this closeout.

records.question: Does reducing the frozen single-eligible-alt BTC reserve from 50% to 40%, reallocating that 10 percentage points to the sole eligible alt while leaving every signal and defensive-scale rule unchanged, materially improve after-cost BRRK compounded growth without unacceptable drawdown, turnover, or right-tail degradation?
records.hypothesis: When exactly one alt is eligible under the frozen BRRK/V1 eligibility rules, the current 50% BTC / 50% alt split is overly conservative. A fixed 40% BTC / 60% sole-eligible-alt split should improve after-cost CAGR while preserving the canonical BRRK right-tail participation and risk-adjusted profile.
records.economic_mechanism: The frozen single-alt branch already identifies one asset as the only eligible relative-strength winner but reserves half of gross for BTC. The candidate changes only that portfolio-construction split, retaining the same gross risk budget, the same BRRK defensive scaler, the same long-only universe, the same signal horizons and the same P3.3 simulation semantics.
records.stopping_rule: Execute exactly one frozen 40/60 single-alt candidate once against the canonical BRRK baseline. If any hard success criterion fails, classify FAIL_NO_PROMOTION and stop this research ID. Do not retune the split, signal horizons, eligibility, caps, defensive scale, cost, P3.3 band, universe, or success gates under this ID after any result is observed.
success_criteria: Candidate after-cost CAGR minus canonical BRRK after-cost CAGR is at least +3.00 percentage points.
Candidate maximum drawdown is no more than 4.00 percentage points worse than canonical BRRK maximum drawdown.
Candidate Calmar ratio is greater than or equal to canonical BRRK Calmar ratio.
Candidate captures at least 98% of canonical BRRK log growth contributed by the canonical best 20 daily return sessions when evaluated on those same dates.
Candidate total turnover is no more than 1.25 times canonical BRRK total turnover under the same simulator.
Candidate remains long-only, target gross never exceeds 1.0, target assets remain exactly BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB, and no production authority changes occur.
failure_criteria: Any hard success criterion failure produces FAIL_NO_PROMOTION for BRRK-WINNER-0001.
Any canonical baseline reproduction failure invalidates the run rather than becoming an economic result.
Any data/PIT/governance or variant-budget violation invalidates the run rather than becoming an economic result.
allowed_followup: A full PASS may create a separately preregistered robustness research ID using a new result-independent contract before any alternative split or broader winner rule is evaluated.
A FAIL may motivate a materially different mechanism only under a new research ID; it may not rescue this ID with a nearby allocation split.
forbidden_followup: No same-ID evaluation of 45/55, 35/65, 30/70 or any other BTC/winner split after observing the 40/60 result.
No modification of the frozen 20/60/120/240 signal horizons or their weights under this ID.
No modification of eligibility rules, multi-alt allocation, ETH/SOL/BNB multi-alt caps, BRRK defensive scaling, leverage, shorting, P3.3 band, cost assumption or universe under this ID.
No direct modification of BRRK-0011, Phase 6, Phase 7 or production authorization from this research result.
researcher_decisions: The only candidate portfolio change is single-alt branch BTC/eligible-alt split 0.50/0.50 -> 0.40/0.60 at unchanged gross.

A single-alt day is identified mechanically from the frozen V1 target structure as BTC plus exactly one nonzero alt in the canonical single-alt branch; ambiguous rows invalidate rather than trigger the candidate.
The candidate uses the same daily BRRK defensive gross scale mechanically established by BRRK-OPPORTUNITY-COST-AUDIT-0042; only normalized target composition changes on eligible single-alt rows.
Canonical price and baseline target reconstruction must reproduce the frozen canonical BRRK metrics within the existing audit tolerance before candidate metrics are released.
Simulation uses the same 5 bps cost and P3.3 economic simulator semantics as the frozen BRRK signal-attribution audit.
The historical window is already researcher-exposed and is DEVELOPMENT evidence only; a PASS does not constitute unbiased OOS confirmation or production evidence.
The canonical best-20 session dates are defined from the canonical baseline only and are not reselected from candidate returns.
records.production_relevance: Research-only portfolio-construction candidate on researcher-exposed history. PASS can only make a separately preregistered robustness stage eligible; it cannot modify canonical BRRK or confer production authority.
notes: Motivated by BRRK-OPPORTUNITY-COST-AUDIT-0042, which found the defensive scaler beneficial historically and found BTC >= 50% of gross on about 70.17% of alt-active V1 days.
The older BRRK signal-attribution audit showed right-tail dependence: canonical best 20 sessions account for about 91.61% of total log growth, motivating the explicit right-tail preservation gate.
One frozen 40/60 candidate executed once in workflow run 31364706555; all preregistered hard gates passed. This creates robustness-stage eligibility only, not canonical or production authority.
